prompt: A slow news-camera zoom in over eight seconds as the tanks go up from left to right, each dome of flame feeding the plume, the biggest at about five seconds. The heat shimmer thickens as the lens lengthens, and every car's hazard lights blink in exact unison. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so anything moving fast smears with natural motion blur. One continuous shot, no cuts.
